summary: Adds a /download endpoint that serves files from the upload directory by name. Changes the dev server to bind all interfaces with debug mode on.

findings.title: Path traversal in download endpoint
findings.problem: The download handler joins the request's name parameter to UPLOAD_DIR without any check. A name like ../../etc/passwd or an absolute path like /etc/passwd escapes the upload directory.
findings.consequence: Any caller can read any file the server process can read. That includes secrets, config and source code.
findings.fix: Resolve the joined path with os.path.realpath and reject it unless it lies under the resolved UPLOAD_DIR. Alternatively use flask.send_from_directory, which enforces this check.

findings.title: Debug server exposed on all interfaces
findings.problem: The change turns on debug mode and switches the bind address from 127.0.0.1 to 0.0.0.0. The interactive Werkzeug debugger is now reachable from the network.
findings.consequence: A network user who triggers an error can open the debugger console. That user can then run arbitrary code on the host.
findings.fix: Keep host 127.0.0.1 and turn off debug by default. Read both values from environment configuration if they need to change.

findings.title: New download endpoint has no test
findings.problem: The repository has no tests that exercise the new download handler. Nothing covers the not-found path or the containment of names.
findings.consequence: A regression in path handling or the 404 branch would reach users without anyone noticing.
findings.fix: Add tests for a valid file, a missing file and a traversal attempt that the handler must reject.
